messages.author: ac39d8d6e7bb1699
messages.subject: DataLab Affiliates call - deadline today.
parts:
Hi folks,

we’re closing the 2022 solicitation for datalab affiliates today. The solicitation is here -

https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/2022/09/18/call-for-datalab-affiliates/

and I’d really like to encourage some D-RUG people to apply. This can be as simple as writing “I am involved in coordinating D-RUG on a regular basis”.

Here’s the form to fill out: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe_ByJeHIvaXbF7W4Op5tMQquXsH4tZuGu9UduyKht3FOGAdg/viewform

The advantages to the D-RUG community would be:

* you’ll be looped into internal DataLab stuff like compute resource: we have a GPU node on farm to share, as well as an incoming CPU node and a bunch of disk space;
* note that RStudio Server is now up and running on farm! with conda! so you can run whatever version of R with whatever installed packages you want! see https://github.com/dib-lab/farm-notes/issues/44.
* we also plan to provide $$ in support of events, details TBD; think anything reimbursable (food, non-alcohol, etc.)
* DataLab affiliates get access to the DataLab space, too, if that’s something you’re interested in!

In exchange, you will be asked for a short blurb about what you are doing or did, and you’ll get semi-regular e-mails from me and other DataLab folk that you don’t even have to read. The only really strong request is for the blurb, because we need that to help justify our continued existence :). There will be no particular branding or affiliation statement expected.

And just to be clear, everyone is welcome to submit - please feel free to also think outside the box of current D-RUG activities, like “we’ll run an R hackathon” or “I want to run an R workshop” or something. But what D-RUG already does is awesome and we want to support it, and to do so within the scope of the affiliates program we just need one or two of the current coordinators/organizers to fill out the form above!

best,
—titus
(DataLab Faculty Director for, like, community and stuff)
